title: Erbil Arrival & Introductory Tour
full_text:
Arrival In Erbil Intl. Airport.
Meet and Greet and transfer from the airport to the hotel.
Introductory tour of the city of Erbil.
Explore the city’s streets, its historic landmarks, and bustling markets.
At night we will enjoy dinner or a cafe and have a feel for the nightlife of the city.
